purpose: Molnupiravir is used to treat mild to moderate COVID-19 in adults who are at high risk of getting very sick or being hospitalized. It is taken as soon as possible after testing positive, ideally within 5 days of symptoms starting. It is not for people who are already in the hospital for COVID-19.
how_it_works: This medicine works by getting inside the COVID-19 virus and messing up its ability to copy itself. It basically introduces errors into the virus's genetic code, so the virus cannot make more copies of itself and spread in your body. Think of it like putting bad instructions into a photocopier so it cannot make good copies anymore.
common_side_effects: The most commonly reported side effects include diarrhea, nausea, and dizziness. Most side effects are mild and go away on their own. Let your doctor or pharmacist know if any side effects bother you or do not go away.
warnings: Do not take this medication if you are pregnant or might become pregnant, as it may harm an unborn baby. Both men and women should use reliable birth control during treatment and for a short time after finishing the course. This medicine is not recommended for children or teenagers under 18. Always tell your doctor about all other medicines you are taking before starting molnupiravir.
typical_dosing: The usual dose is 4 capsules (800 mg total) taken by mouth twice a day, once in the morning and once in the evening, for 5 days in a row. Take it with or without food. Try to take it at the same times each day and finish all 5 days even if you start feeling better.
